entities.name: Géza Horváth
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Géza Horváth was a Hungarian medical doctor and entomologist internationally recognized for his work on bugs (Hemiptera). He also contributed extensively to the study of Hungarian scale insect fauna. He published over 350 papers in his lifetime.
